title: Battle Readiness and the Opening Clash

blocks.text: Once pursuit becomes unavoidable, the Singhs prepare through prayer and resolve, and kar ardâs singh janglai dhâyô gives the page its battle readiness before the clash begins.
Sahib Rai identifies the supposed culprit with yahî chôr hai ghôrdîan vârô, turning accusation into a signal for attack and making clear that this contest is now public and violent.
Weapons answer immediately: in nai hi thé dangô uthâyâ leads into ui tir bandôk tak use chalânhin, and the page records the first open exchange of gunfire, arrows, and casualties.
